text: This jet ran out of fuel at forty-one thousand feet, because of one number.
In nineteen eighty-three, a brand-new seven sixty-seven measured its fuel in kilograms. But its fuel gauges were broken.
So the crew measured the tanks with a stick, and turned litres into weight.
They multiplied by one point seven seven. But that's pounds per litre. The right number was about zero point eight.
The plane took off with less than half the fuel it needed.
Over Ontario, both engines went silent.
How sixty-nine people survived is even crazier. Full video on my channel.
